entry.title: Make the meeting worth it
entry.use_when: A point, a plan, and fewer “quick follow-ups.”
entry.freshness: Review after use; verify current external facts before relying on them.
entry.limitations: A reusable prompt for an existing assistant; tool access and authority come from the actual task.

variants.label: Prepare a decision meeting
variants.method: Put the decision and options on the agenda, name the required input for each discussion and time-box information sharing.
variants.output: A short agenda with decision points and preparation requests.

variants.label: Recover the decisions
variants.method: Extract explicit agreements, owner commitments and unresolved disagreements; attach note locations where the evidence is ambiguous.
variants.output: A decision/action recap with uncertainty preserved.

pattern.activation: a meeting needs a purpose, a decision or follow-through from its notes.
